items.description: Server + wire: add a wait-leave path so abandoned waiters never dead-pair. Per .planning/todos/pending/2026-10-27-abandoned-waiters-dead-pair-with-next-arriver.md: a wait-leave endpoint (bearer participant token; LREM queue entry, delete wait entry + token ref), called from the iOS "step back out" action (AppModel.leave() when there is no session yet); matchmaker additionally skips+cleans queue entries whose owner stopped polling (last-polled-at on WaitEntry, ~3x the 3s poll interval), without blocking an opted-in arriver's bot window; LocalBackend/FakeBackend mirror the Backend protocol change; race tests alongside TestHumanVsBotRaceSingleSession.

iOS: add a quiet leave affordance to ComposeView (both your-turn and their-turn states) wired to the existing AppModel.leave(), so a stuck session has an escape. Per .planning/todos/pending/2026-10-27-add-leave-affordance-to-compose.md: match the ritual tone (quiet chrome like the Threshold gear / "step away" phrasing), keep the dissolution flow, pin the copy with tests.
